methodology.data: Synthetic labelled fixtures; 12 scenario/attack families with parameter variations. Not 500 distinct real documents.
methodology.planning_oracle: Independent Decimal capacity oracle on one-obligation generated cases; broader graph invariants in pytest.
methodology.security: Actual routers, authentication and database operations in isolated SQLite; PostgreSQL and transport exercised separately by Playwright.
methodology.recovery: Conditional feasibility after explicit installment acceptance; no real transfers.
methodology.baselines: Executable heuristics. B3 is a demo approximation, not an external LLM result.
